column7: a key-material set assembled from two generations refuses to start, whatever the files' mtimes: every present required key file is hashed and compared with the key-set manifest (keyset.manifest.json, written by every key writer; structural guard TestEveryKeyMaterialWriterUpdatesTheManifest), and a file matching neither its recorded nor a staged hash refuses boot naming it. Proven on a set built with plain cp (identical, current mtimes), which the mtime heuristic this replaced passed. Scope: a set that HAS a manifest; a set without one is adopted with a WARN and an audit event (pre-manifest installs, #2900 criterion 4). Not an authenticator: the hashes are unkeyed, so this detects accidents, not an attacker who can write the key directory
